compiled_state.title: Execute dogfooding brainstorm session 1 and capture PRECONDITIONS event path
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Purpose
Run the first dogfooding brainstorm session using /dso:brainstorm on the first target epic selected in the prerequisite task. Observe Phase 1 Gate behavior and record whether a META_QUESTION signal is emitted.

## Steps
1. Run /dso:brainstorm on target epic 1 (identified in prerequisite task)
2. Complete the Phase 1 Gate sequence through Understanding Summary, Intent Gap Analysis, and the completeness attestation sub-step
3. After the session, use the ticket CLI to check if PRECONDITIONS events were written: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show <epic-id> and inspect preconditions_summary
4. Check whether META_QUESTION signal was surfaced during Phase 1 Gate (observable as explicit user prompt in the brainstorm dialogue)
5. Document the user answer — was it null (default / proceed) or a substantive correction?

## Done
- Brainstorm session 1 completed for target epic 1
- PRECONDITIONS event accessible (preconditions_summary.status != pre-manifest)
- Result documented as ticket comment on 745a-b46d: SESSION_1: epic=<id>, preconditions_accessible=<yes|no>, meta_question_fired=<yes|no>, user_answer=<answer|null>
